subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
topic: Instrument elements and mechanism: - Elements, mechanisms, lever mechanisms, gears, hair springs, etc.
syllabus_extract: Instrument elements and mechanism: - Elements, mechanisms, lever mechanisms, gears, hair springs, etc.
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.2 Trainee will be able to explain the basic elements and mechanisms of an instrument.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of instrument mechanism assembly; Safety: Handle delicate springs with care; Supervision: Instructor monitors handling of hair springs and gears.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft flight instrument?
Name three basic elements found in a mechanical flight instrument.
How does a change in physical quantity affect the instrument mechanism?

development.content:
Basic instrument elements
Mechanism types overview
Lever mechanism principles
Gear train operation
Hair spring function

Detailed lever analysis
Gear ratio calculations
Hair spring torque characteristics
Mechanism assembly demonstration
Error sources in mechanisms

Integration of elements
Mechanism reliability factors
Maintenance requirements
Troubleshooting common failures
Summary of key points

summary_questions: Explain how a lever mechanism amplifies input motion.
Describe the role of the hair spring in restoring the instrument pointer.
Identify two factors that affect the accuracy of gear trains.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of lever mechanisms and gears will be applied in the next lesson regarding temperature compensation methods.

pft_rows.syllabus: Temperature compensation of instrument mechanisms: - Bimetal strip method, thermo resistance method, thermo magnetic shunt method.
